newsitem.title: USA: Centura Banks says to buy 13 bank branches.
newsitem.headline: Centura Banks says to buy 13 bank branches.

text.p: Centura Banks Inc said it agreed to buy 13 banking offices in North Carolina from United Carolina Bancshares Corp.
Centura said the branches have deposits of $311 million and loans of about $200 million. The acquisition will push its assets above $6.7 billion, the company said.
The company said it expects the deal to add value for its shareholders almost immediately. It said it expects to complete the deal by mid-August.
The sale is one of a pair of transactions in which United Carolina and BB&T Corp are selling 23 branches in connection with their pending merger.
In the other transaction, also announced today, Triangle Bancorp Inc agreed to buy a total of 10 branches from the two banking companies.
